notes: v483 — 🛠️ Two real fixes and a slimmer app. Leaving 🎓 Training mode used to wipe every share off your screen — that is fixed; your market now stays exactly where it was. Training mode also made the app crawl once a full exchange was loaded: it now switches on instantly and explains each control the moment you hover it, however many shares you have. And the demo data has been removed — nothing used it, and the app is a fifth smaller to download without it. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
